metadata.description: ACE BATTLE RUN — a new tactical team race format. Roles, tactics, and an official ranking.

five.title: You can reach the international level

path.foot: The Warsaw Qualifier is your start in the ACE BATTLE RUN system in Poland. <red>Become part of a brand-new competition format from the very beginning.</red>

people.title: New connections

faq.title: Got questions?
faq.sub: our manager will reach out and answer everything

noTeam.q: Can I come without a team?
noTeam.a: Yes! Register without hesitation — we'll match you with a team inside the ACE BATTLE community. Or choose the Solo format for an individual run with a personal rating. A team is not required.

kids.a: Yes, kids are welcome as spectators alongside adults. Participation in the run depends on the format's age rules.

prep.a: No. The format is designed for any level — from beginners to seasoned runners. What matters is team spirit and the will to play.

bring.a: Comfortable sportswear and shoes, a good mood, and a bit of water. You'll get your bib and timing chip on site.

spectator.q: Can I come as a spectator?
spectator.a: Of course! We have stands for fans, an on-site café, and a full show throughout the day.
